name: Saber
description:
The solitary Heroic Spirit traverses the long night of fate. The banner of the round table remains unfurled in a dream. Alas, the knight-king of Camelot has yet to reach that ever-distant utopia.
Though still a young maiden, she has heeded the call for this most unique iteration of the Holy Grail War. With the Sword in the Stone offering its choice once more, how shall she shatter the illusions of the past?
— "The wishes I did not fulfill will end here."

skills.name: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Wind DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Saber's ATK to adjacent targets. If Saber currently holds "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after this instance of Skill attack, then increases the multiplier for this instance of Skill. For every 1 point of "Core Resonance," increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill by #4[f1]%. And after the attack, consumes all "Core Resonance" to regenerate Energy for Saber. Otherwise, immediately gains #3[i] point(s) of "Core Resonance."
skills.simpleDesc: Deals Wind DMG to one designated enemy and minor Wind DMG to adjacent targets. If Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after attacking, then increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill based on "Core Resonance" points and consumes all "Core Resonance" after the attack. Otherwise, gains #3[i] "Core Resonance" point(s).

skills.name: Excalibur
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Saber's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Saber's ATK dealt to one random enemy. After using Ultimate, the next Basic ATK switches to "Release, the Golden Scepter," and only "Release, the Golden Scepter" can be used.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals massive Wind DMG to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Wind DMG to random enemies, bouncing #3[i] time(s). And enhances the next Basic ATK.

skills.name: Dragon Reactor Core
skills.desc: When entering combat, gains #8[i] "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Saber by #3[i]% for #4[i] turn(s) and gains #1[i] "Core Resonance" point(s). For every 1 "Core Resonance" point consumed, regenerates a fixed amount of #5[f1] Energy for Saber.
skills.simpleDesc: When entering combat, gains #8[i] "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Saber and gains #1[i] "Core Resonance" point(s). Consuming "Core Resonance" will regenerate Energy for Saber.

skills.name: Behold, the King of Knights
skills.desc: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, increases Saber's ATK by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s) and gains #3[i] "Core Resonance."
skills.simpleDesc: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains #3[i] "Core Resonance" point(s) and increases ATK.

eidolons.name: The Lost White Walls
eidolons.desc: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber by 60%. After Saber uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 "Core Resonance."

eidolons.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
eidolons.desc: For every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, Saber's DMG dealt ignores 1% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 15 time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance" effect to boost Skill's multiplier, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for the current instance of Skill by 7%.

eidolons.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
eidolons.desc: Increases Saber's Wind <u>RES PEN</u> by 8%. After using Ultimate, increases Saber's Wind <u>RES PEN</u> by 4%. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s).

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

eidolons.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: The Long Fated Night
eidolons.desc: The Wind <u>RES PEN</u> of the Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber increases by 20%. The amount of overflow Energy that can be accumulated with the Trace "<link kind="trace" to="blessing_of_the_lake">Blessing of the Lake</link>" increases to 200. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of 300 Energy for Saber. This effect can trigger 1 time after every 3 Ultimate use(s).

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

embedBonusSkill.name: Knight of the Dragon
embedBonusSkill.desc: Increases Saber's CRIT Rate by 20%. When entering combat or when using her Enhanced Basic ATK, gains the "Mana Burst" effect. Under this effect, if Saber has "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by using her Skill and consuming "Core Resonance," then consumes "Mana Burst" to recover 1 Skill Point for allies, and causes Saber to immediately take action.

embedBonusSkill.name: Blessing of the Lake
embedBonusSkill.desc: Saber can accumulate up to 120 overflow Energy. After using Ultimate, the overflow Energy is cleared and a corresponding amount of Energy is regenerated. When the battle starts, if Energy is below 60%, it is regenerated to 60%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Crown of the Star
embedBonusSkill.desc: When using Skill, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by 50% for 2 turns. During this battle, for every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by 4%, stacking up to 8 time(s).
